title: 第七章 命格第八章 本源玄灵
content_zh:
张无定（八品武者），命格：二两三钱，可转为二两三钱本源玄灵……
周无纪通过和北帝天刑书的联系，他自然明白了书页上怎么会出现了张无定，也明白了怎么使用书页上的张无定。
北帝天刑书收取了张无定死后散逸的灵性，凝聚在书页上。
这点灵性可以转为本源玄灵，用来感悟武功、法术。
命格分量越大，转化的本源玄灵越强。
就像那个煞鬼一样，北帝天刑书可以量化玄灵……
当然，这种转化需要严格遵守戒律。
他已经违背了数条戒律，一行行红字后面都标注着概免。
若没有这个特性，连他在内全家上下几代血亲都要死绝了！
河边的熊熊烈焰逐渐熄灭，周无纪却目光深沉若有所思，这让一旁的众多弟子、杂役也都不敢出声。
过了好一会，周无纪搞清楚了北帝天刑书的变化，却没有急着使用张无定转化的本源灵光。
周无纪走上前对着师父烧化骨灰深深叩拜，口中默诵《太上往生咒》。
连续诵念三遍《太上往生咒》，周无纪把剩下的木炭、骨灰都扬到河里。
圆月当空，河水滔滔，带着飞扬尘灰汹涌直下，转眼就淹没了一切痕迹。
他默默祷念：“师父、你喜欢潇江湘江，这里顺着画眉河直下九源江，就是潇江湘江交汇之处，想来您老人家也会喜欢吧……”
周无纪又出了一会神，这才一拂袖对众人说道：“都回大殿。”
众人也不敢说什么，乖乖跟着周无纪回到七星大殿。
“诸位，没我的允许不得离开大殿。明白么？”周无纪沉声说道。
众人不敢违抗，或是低声应是，或是连连点头。
周无纪瞥了眼大殿上两具尸体，却也没去理会。暂时放一会也不碍事。

有血淋淋教训摆在眼前，也能让众人都冷静一些，能有效避免他们做傻事。
从后面通道离开大殿的时候，周无纪想了下把人群中的李如意叫了出来。
“无意，你过来我有话和你说。”
众人目光都看向李如意，李如意是位十七岁少女，肤色白皙明眸清亮，五官秀美，身材修长挺拔。
哪怕做道士打扮，也掩盖不住秀美挺拔风姿。
李如意，她平素和周无纪关系虽然还行，这会却真不想和周无纪私下相处。
但她也不敢违抗召唤，当下面无表情的慢步跟上周无纪。
负责保护李如意的中年女子想要跟过来，却被李如意摆手阻止了。
绕过大殿从后门出来，就到了后院。这里左右都有厢房，正房五间。
院子平日都是用来练武学法，很是宽敞开阔。
周围房间里没点灯，只有天上星辰闪耀，院子里显得颇为晦暗幽深。
李如意慢慢走到后院，就看到周无纪负手站在院子中间，正打量着前方师父住的正房，也不知在想什么。
她一直觉得周无纪性子温和，甚至称得上老实。这份不争不抢，还真有几分道家讲的无为。
只是在这乱世，落后一步就要任人宰割。不论练武还是修道，都要奋勇争先。
什么无为无争，说说也就罢了，岂能当真。
所以，李如意在心里一直觉得周无纪有些无能。
content_en:
Zhang Wuding (eighth-level warrior), destiny: Two taels and three coins can be converted into two taels and three coins of the original mysterious spirit...
Through Zhou Wuji's contact with the Beidi Tianxing Book, he naturally understood why Zhang Wuding appeared on the page and how to use Zhang Wuding on the page.
The Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book collects Zhang Wuding's scattered spirituality after his death and condenses it on the pages.
This bit of spirituality can be turned into the original mysterious spirit, which can be used to comprehend martial arts and magic.
The greater the weight of the destiny, the stronger the original mysterious spirit transformed.
Just like that evil ghost, Beidi's Heavenly Punishment Book can quantify mysterious spirits...
Of course, this transformation requires strict observance of the commandments.
He had already broken several commandments, with exemptions marked behind them in red letters.
Without this characteristic, even generations of blood relatives in his family would be dead!
The blazing flames by the river gradually extinguished, but Zhou Wuji's eyes were deep and thoughtful, which made many disciples and servants on the side dare not speak out.
After a while, Zhou Wuji figured out the changes in the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book, but he was not in a hurry to use the original aura transformed by Zhang Wuding.
Zhou Wuji stepped forward and bowed deeply to his master's burned ashes, silently reciting "The Supreme Rebirth Mantra".
After reciting the "Tai Shang Rebirth Mantra" three times in a row, Zhou Wuji threw the remaining charcoal and ashes into the river.
The full moon was in the sky, and the river was surging, carrying flying dust and dust, and it swamped all traces in the blink of an eye.
He prayed silently: "Master, you like the Xiaojiang and Xiangjiang rivers. This place goes straight down to the Jiuyuan River along the Huamei River and is where the Xiaojiang and Xiangjiang rivers meet. I think you will also like it..."
Zhou Wuji was lost in thought for a while, then he waved his sleeves and said to everyone: "Everyone go back to the main hall."
Everyone did not dare to say anything and followed Zhou Wuji back to the Seven Stars Hall obediently.
"Everyone, you are not allowed to leave the hall without my permission. Do you understand?" Zhou Wuji said in a deep voice.
Everyone did not dare to disobey, either whispered in agreement, or nodded repeatedly.
Zhou Wuji glanced at the two corpses in the hall, but ignored them. It doesn't matter if you leave it alone for a while.
Having a bloody lesson in front of you can also make everyone calm down and effectively prevent them from doing stupid things.
When leaving the main hall from the back passage, Zhou Wuji thought for a moment and called Li Ruyi out of the crowd.
"No intention, come here and I have something to tell you."
Everyone looked at Li Ruyi. Li Ruyi was a seventeen-year-old girl with fair complexion, bright eyes, beautiful facial features, and a slender and tall figure.
Even if you dress up as a Taoist priest, you can't hide your beauty and upright grace.
Li Ruyi, although she usually has a good relationship with Zhou Wuji, she really doesn't want to get along with Zhou Wuji in private now.
But she didn't dare to disobey the call and followed Zhou Wuji slowly and expressionlessly.
The middle-aged woman responsible for protecting Li Ruyi wanted to follow, but Li Ruyi waved her hand to stop her.
Go around the main hall and out the back door to the backyard. There are side rooms on the left and right, and there are five main rooms.
The courtyard is usually used for martial arts training and learning, and it is very spacious and open.
There were no lights in the surrounding rooms, only the stars in the sky were shining, and the yard seemed quite dark and deep.
Li Ruyi walked slowly to the backyard and saw Zhou Wuji standing in the middle of the yard with his hands behind his hands, looking at the main house where his master lived in front of him, not knowing what he was thinking.
She had always felt that Zhou Wuji was gentle and even honest. This non-competition and non-grabbing is really a bit like the Taoist concept of inaction.
But in these troubled times, if you fall one step behind, you will be at the mercy of others. Regardless of whether you are practicing martial arts or practicing Taoism, you must strive to be the first.
There is nothing to do or argue about, just talk about it, how can it be taken seriously?
Therefore, Li Ruyi always felt that Zhou Wuji was somewhat incompetent.
